Key Nutrients: Protein (9g), Fat (18g), Carbohydrates (56g), Fiber (6g), Potassium, Calcium
Ingredients Required: Whole wheat flour, Boiled potatoes, Green chillies, Chopped onions, Ginger, Amchur powder, Garam masala, Kasuri methi, Salt, Desi Ghee, Fresh white butter (Makhan)
Recipe Instructions: 1. Mash boiled potatoes with onions, green chillies, ginger, amchur, garam masala, and salt. 2. Stuff spiced potato mixture inside whole wheat dough ball, roll into flat circle. 3. Roast on tawa with desi ghee till golden brown. Serve hot with a dollop of fresh white butter and curd.

Key Nutrients: Protein (14g), Fat (20g), Carbohydrates (44g), Fiber (5g), Calcium, Phosphorus
Ingredients Required: Whole wheat flour, Crumbled Paneer (Cottage cheese), Green chillies, Roasted cumin powder, Amchur powder, Hing (Asafoetida), Coriander leaves, Salt, Desi Ghee
Recipe Instructions: 1. Mix crumbled paneer with finely green chillies, cumin powder, amchur, hing, coriander, and salt (strictly no onion, garlic, or ginger). 2. Stuff into wheat dough, roll carefully, and roast on tawa with ghee until golden crisp.

Key Nutrients: Protein (12g), Fat (20g), Carbohydrates (64g), Fiber (10g), Iron, Folate
Ingredients Required: Chickpeas (Kabuli Chana), Whole wheat flour, Tomatoes, Ginger, Green chillies, Tea bag (for dark color), Chole masala, Cumin seeds, Amchur, Vegetable oil for frying
Recipe Instructions: 1. Pressure cook chickpeas with tea bag, salt, and water. 2. Prepare gravy by cooking tomato puree, ginger, green chillies, and chole masala in oil until oil separates. Mix with cooked chana and simmer till thick. 3. Knead tight wheat dough, roll pooris, and deep fry until puffed.

Key Nutrients: Protein (28g), Fat (22g), Carbohydrates (45g), Fiber (4g), Iron, Niacin
Ingredients Required: Minced Chicken (Keema), Whole wheat flour, Onions, Ginger-garlic paste, Green chillies, Punjabi garam masala, Red chilli powder, Ghee/Oil, Fresh coriander
Recipe Instructions: 1. Sauté keema with onions, ginger-garlic paste, green chillies, and Punjabi garam masala until cooked and dry. 2. Stuff seasoned keema into wheat dough, roll into paratha, and cook on tawa with generous ghee until crispy.

Dish Name: Sarson Ka Saag & Makki Ki Roti
Key Nutrients: Protein (11g), Fat (22g), Carbohydrates (55g), Fiber (11g), Calcium, Iron, Vit A & C
Ingredients Required: Mustard greens (Sarson), Spinach (Palak), Bathua greens, Maize flour (Makki atta), Garlic, Ginger, Green chillies, Onions, Desi Ghee, White butter, Jaggery
Recipe Instructions: 1. Wash and boil sarson, palak, and bathua greens. Mash coarsely and thicken with makki atta. 2. Prepare tadka in ghee with onions, ginger, garlic, green chillies; mix into saag and simmer. 3. Flatten makki flour into rotis by hand, cook on tawa with ghee, serve with saag, white butter, and jaggery.

Key Nutrients: Protein (15g), Fat (18g), Carbohydrates (42g), Fiber (10g), Calcium, Iron
Ingredients Required: Whole Black Gram (Sabut Urad), Rajma (Kidney beans), Fresh Tomato puree, Butter, Fresh Cream, Hing (Asafoetida), Red chilli powder, Kasuri methi, Cumin seeds, Salt
Recipe Instructions: 1. Pressure cook black urad and rajma until butter-soft. 2. Heat butter, temper cumin seeds and hing. Add fresh tomato puree, red chilli powder, and salt; cook until butter separates. 3. Add cooked lentils, slow cook on low heat for 1 hour while stirring. Finish with cream and kasuri methi.

Key Nutrients: Protein (14g), Fat (10g), Carbohydrates (50g), Fiber (12g), Iron, Magnesium
Ingredients Required: Kabuli Chana, Anardana (Dried pomegranate seeds), Black cardamom, Cloves, Cinnamon, Ginger juliennes, Green chillies, Chole masala, Mustard oil
Recipe Instructions: 1. Boil chickpeas with whole black spices and tea bag. 2. Toss boiled chana with roasted anardana powder, chole masala, amchur, and salt till dark and coated. 3. Heat mustard oil till smoking, pour over chana with slit green chillies and ginger juliennes (dry-style dish).

Key Nutrients: Protein (38g), Fat (42g), Carbohydrates (14g), Fiber (2g), Calcium, Vitamin A
Ingredients Required: Boneless Chicken, Yogurt, Ginger-garlic paste, Tandoori masala, Butter, Ripe tomatoes, Cashew paste, Fresh cream, Kasuri methi, Honey/Sugar
Recipe Instructions: 1. Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices; grill or roast until charred. 2. Simmer tomato puree with butter, cashew paste, and garam masala till smooth and velvety. 3. Add grilled chicken pieces, cream, honey, and crushed kasuri methi. Simmer for 10 minutes.

Key Nutrients: Protein (18g), Fat (22g), Carbohydrates (12g), Fiber (2g), Calcium, Phosphorus
Ingredients Required: Paneer cubes, Bell peppers, Onions, Hung curd, Mustard oil, Besan, Ginger-garlic paste, Chaat masala, Ajwain, Lemon juice
Recipe Instructions: 1. Whisk hung curd with roasted besan, mustard oil, ginger-garlic paste, ajwain, and spices. 2. Coat paneer cubes, onion, and bell peppers in marinade; rest for 30 minutes. 3. Thread onto skewers and grill/bake until charred at edges. Sprinkle chaat masala.

Key Nutrients: Protein (18g), Fat (22g), Carbohydrates (10g), Fiber (2g), Calcium, Phosphorus
Ingredients Required: Paneer cubes, Capsicum/Bell peppers, Hung curd, Mustard oil, Roasted besan, Hing, Roasted cumin powder, Kasuri methi, Lemon juice, Chaat masala
Recipe Instructions: 1. Whisk hung curd with roasted besan, mustard oil, hing, cumin powder, kasuri methi, and salt (no garlic, ginger, or onions). 2. Marinate paneer and bell pepper cubes. 3. Skewer and grill until smoky and slightly golden.

Key Nutrients: Protein (14g), Fat (22g), Carbohydrates (68g), Fiber (8g), Sodium, Iron
Ingredients Required: Maida, Boiled mashed potatoes, Chopped onions, Anardana, Green chillies, Butter, Curd, Baking powder, Spiced chickpeas
Recipe Instructions: 1. Prepare leavened maida dough with curd and baking powder. 2. Stuff dough with mashed potato, onion, crushed anardana, and spices; roll thick. 3. Bake in tandoor or tawa with water splash, crush lightly, and drench in melted butter. Serve with spicy chole.

Key Nutrients: Protein (28g), Fat (20g), Carbohydrates (16g), Fiber (2g), Omega-3, Vit B12
Ingredients Required: Sole / Singhada Fish fillets, Besan (Gram flour), Ajwain (Carom seeds), Ginger-garlic paste, Red chilli powder, Lemon juice, Chaat masala, Oil for deep frying
Recipe Instructions: 1. Marinate fish fillets with ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice, red chilli, and salt. 2. Coat in a batter of besan, ajwain, and water. 3. Deep fry in hot oil until extra crisp. Sprinkle generous chaat masala.

Key Nutrients: Protein (16g), Fat (32g), Carbohydrates (20g), Fiber (2g), Calcium, Vit A
Ingredients Required: Paneer, Tomatoes, Onions, Ginger, Garlic, Cashews, Melon seeds (Magajtari), Fresh cream, Shahi jeera, Cardamom, Ghee, Kasuri methi
Recipe Instructions: 1. Boil tomatoes, onions, cashews, and melon seeds; blend into a silky smooth paste. 2. Cook paste in ghee with whole spices and ginger-garlic. 3. Add paneer cubes, cream, kasuri methi, and simmer for 5-7 minutes till rich and creamy.

Key Nutrients: Protein (16g), Fat (32g), Carbohydrates (18g), Fiber (2g), Calcium
Ingredients Required: Paneer, Tomatoes, Cashews, Milk, Fresh cream, Desi Ghee, Hing, Shahi jeera, Green cardamom, Saffron, Sugar, Salt
Recipe Instructions: 1. Boil tomatoes and cashews; blend into a fine purée. 2. Heat ghee, temper shahi jeera, hing, and cardamom. Add tomato-cashew paste and cook till ghee separates. 3. Add milk, saffron, paneer cubes, cream, and simmer on low heat.

Key Nutrients: Protein (4g), Fat (12g), Carbohydrates (24g), Fiber (8g), Potassium, Vit C
Ingredients Required: Large Eggplant (Bhartay wala Baingan), Onions, Tomatoes, Green chillies, Ginger, Mustard oil, Cumin seeds, Coriander leaves, Red chilli powder
Recipe Instructions: 1. Roast eggplant directly over open flame until skin is charred and flesh soft; peel skin and mash. 2. Heat mustard oil, sauté cumin, onions, ginger, and green chillies until golden. 3. Add tomatoes and dry spices; cook till soft, fold in mashed eggplant and sauté for 10 minutes.

Key Nutrients: Protein (4g), Fat (12g), Carbohydrates (22g), Fiber (8g), Potassium
Ingredients Required: Large Eggplant, Tomatoes, Green chillies, Mustard oil, Cumin seeds, Hing (Asafoetida), Turmeric, Red chilli powder, Coriander powder, Salt
Recipe Instructions: 1. Roast eggplant over open flame, peel, and mash. 2. Heat mustard oil, add cumin seeds and hing. 3. Add chopped tomatoes, green chillies, and spices; cook until tomatoes turn soft. Toss in mashed eggplant and roast well on medium flame.

Key Nutrients: Protein (42g), Fat (38g), Carbohydrates (12g), Fiber (2g), Iron, Zinc, Vit B12
Ingredients Required: Mutton pieces with bone, Minced Mutton (Keema), Onions, Tomato puree, Ginger-garlic paste, Whisked curd, Whole spices, Punjabi Garam Masala, Ghee
Recipe Instructions: 1. Sauté whole spices and onions in ghee until deep brown. Add ginger-garlic and curd. 2. Add mutton pieces and cook till seared, then add minced mutton (keema) and tomato puree. 3. Slow cook on low heat for 1.5 hours adding water as needed until meat is fall-apart tender and rich gravy forms.

Key Nutrients: Protein (7g), Fat (18g), Carbohydrates (48g), Fiber (4g), Vitamin A, Calcium
Ingredients Required: Red Delhi Carrots (grated), Full-cream Milk, Khoya/Mawa, Desi Ghee, Sugar, Cardamom powder, Almonds, Pistachios, Cashews
Recipe Instructions: 1. Cook grated carrots in milk on medium heat until milk evaporates completely. 2. Add desi ghee and sauté carrots for 10-15 minutes. 3. Mix in sugar, khoya, cardamom powder, and nuts; cook until ghee separates.

Key Nutrients: Protein (6g), Fat (10g), Carbohydrates (44g), Fiber (0.5g), Calcium, Phosphorus
Ingredients Required: Basmati Rice (soaked & coarsely ground), Full-cream Milk, Sugar, Saffron strands, Cardamom powder, Rose water, Slivered nuts
Recipe Instructions: 1. Boil milk and slowly whisk in coarsely ground rice paste to avoid lumps. 2. Cook on low flame stirring continuously until thick and creamy. 3. Add sugar, saffron milk, and cardamom. Set in clay bowls (Matkas) and chill before serving.

Key Nutrients: Protein (5g), Fat (14g), Carbohydrates (44g), Fiber (0g), Calcium
Ingredients Required: Mawa/Khoya, Paneer, Maida, Cardamom powder, Ghee for deep frying, Sugar syrup (flavored with Saffron and Rose water)
Recipe Instructions: 1. Knead khoya, paneer, and maida into a smooth soft dough; roll into crack-free balls. 2. Deep fry in ghee on low heat until dark golden brown. 3. Soak immediately in warm saffron-cardamom sugar syrup for at least 2 hours.

Key Nutrients: Protein (8g), Fat (20g), Carbohydrates (60g), Fiber (0.5g), Calcium
Ingredients Required: Maida, Curd, Baking soda, Ghee for frying, Sugar syrup, Saffron, Full-cream milk (for Rabri), Cardamom powder, Chopped nuts
Recipe Instructions: 1. Prepare fermented maida batter, pipe spiral shapes into hot ghee, fry until crispy, and soak in saffron sugar syrup. 2. Reduce milk continuously to make thick Rabri. Serve hot crisp jalebis topped with chilled thick rabri.
